_note: The update policy every Rahpoo app reads at launch. This copy is only for review; the live one is the root of github.com/MajidsaffarianZadeh/rahpoo-config. One key per app - an app that is not listed is not governed. See docs/update-gate.md.
_rule: Raise min ONLY after that exact versionCode is live and approved in that exact market. latest = what the market really has, 0 = say nothing.
_nikipoo: The nikipoo family (nikipoo, tizbin, temsah) carries NO latest key on purpose: its client asks the store itself (BazaarUpdater on Bazaar, Play In-App Updates, the myket://check-update intent) instead of a hand-kept number. Only min lives here, for the one thing no store can say - this build may no longer run. Its client also ignores min whenever the store reports the installed build is already the newest, so an early min cannot strand anyone; that guard does NOT work on Myket, which answers nothing. versionCode bases differ: nikipoo 50000+, tizbin and temsah 10000+.
_markets: ca = Cafe Bazaar, mk = Myket, all = fallback for a market with no entry of its own. Google Play is ps for hokm/shelem (Java client) and gp for the nikipoo family (Flutter client reads the market string straight from its manifest) - each app must be keyed the way its own build spells it.
